# ezCORE v0.1.1 — first legal-clean release

v0.1.1 is the first release built after the license audit. It ships only
cores whose licenses permit distribution — **FinalBurn Neo, Snes9x, and
Genesis Plus GX are no longer bundled** (they remain available as build
recipes for local use). Everything else is the same as v0.1.0: the same
console-style UI, local saves, cheats, and shader support. This is still an
early build and things may not work as expected.

## What's in this build

| Platform | Artifact | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| macOS arm64 | `ezcore-0.1.1-macos-arm64.zip` | Ad-hoc signed + sandboxed. Unzip, drag to Applications, right-click → Open the first time (no notarization yet). |
| Android arm64 | `ezcore-0.1.1-android-arm64.apk` | Release-signed; installs via `adb install` or sideload. arm64 devices only. |
| Windows / Linux | — | Shells compile but no builds published yet. |

- Cores bundled: **15** (macOS) / **8** (Android). Removed from v0.1.0:
  FinalBurn Neo, Snes9x, Genesis Plus GX (non-commercial licenses).
  Remaining: SameBoy, Gambatte, mGBA, Mesen, Stella, Beetle PCE,
  Beetle Saturn, Dolphin (macOS only), DOSBox Pure, Flycast, MelonDS,
  Mupen64Plus, PPSSPP, ScummVM, SwanStation.
- Verification level: **3** render-verified (SameBoy, Gambatte, mGBA),
  **12** load-and-identify — exact per-core state in `docs/MATRIX.md`.
  GPU-renderer cores (Saturn, N64, PSP, Dreamcast, DS, PS1) are experimental.

## Known limitations

- No BIOS or games bundled — you need your own dumps.
- iOS, Windows, Linux not shipped yet.
- Save/state formats not frozen — expect changes before v1.0.
- macOS sandboxed — reads only files you pick.
- Ad-hoc signed only — no notarization yet (macOS may warn on first open).

## Reporting

- **Found a bug?** Open an issue with your platform + exact steps.
- **Fixed it?** PRs welcome — see `CONTRIBUTING.md`.
- This is still an early build: if something looks wrong, it probably is — tell us.
